meta.name: figma-automation
meta.description: Automate Figma tasks via Rube MCP (Composio): files, components, design tokens, comments, exports. Always search tools first for current schemas.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动完成 Figma 文件、组件、设计令牌等任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常在 Figma 中重复操作设计元素
copy.tagline_en: Automate Figma tasks like files, components, design tokens
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently repeat design operations in Figma

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以读取 Figma 设计文件、提取组件和设计变量、导出图片、管理评论和版本，以及浏览团队项目。
howto.when: 当你提供 Figma 文件链接或要求查看、导出设计内容时触发。

say.text: 帮我读取这个 Figma 文件的所有组件。
say.note: Claude 会解析文件并列出组件。

say.text: 把这个 Figma 文件中的设计变量导出为 Tailwind 配置。
say.note: Claude 会提取变量并转换。

say.text: 给这个 Figma 文件添加一条评论，说‘颜色需要调整’。
say.note: Claude 会在文件上添加评论。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can read Figma design files, extract components and design tokens, export images, manage comments and versions, and browse team projects.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a Figma file link or ask to view/export design content.

say_en.text: Read all components from this Figma file.
say_en.note: Claude will parse the file and list components.

say_en.text: Export design tokens from this Figma file as a Tailwind config.
say_en.note: Claude will extract tokens and convert them.

say_en.text: Add a comment to this Figma file saying 'Colors need adjustment'.
say_en.note: Claude will add a comment to the file.
